author: Nuon Bonong
changelog: Grade 8 Worksheets, Quizzes, & Question Bank complete upgrade: audited all mathematical typesetting (eliminated raw slash fractions, standardized \dfrac, fixed \ldots and KaTeX math delimiters, converted currency signs to \text{ ដុល្លារ}); strictly aligned exercises with MoEYS curriculum progression across all 18 lessons (74 points) from Chapter 1 to Chapter 4; created 3 distinct difficulty levels per point (Level 1 Easy, Level 2 Medium, Level 3 Hard) totaling 222 comprehensive exercises with detailed teacher solutions, rubrics, and dynamic score calculation (/ ៣); audited 740 point quiz questions and 805 question bank questions for zero math typography errors.
